parameters.query: INSERT INTO content_events (job_id,event_type,message,metadata) VALUES (NULLIF('{{$json.job_id}}','')::uuid, COALESCE('{{$json.event_type}}','progress'), COALESCE('{{$json.message}}','Progress update'), COALESCE(NULLIF('{{$json.metadata_json}}',''),'{}')::jsonb); SELECT NULLIF('{{$json.job_id}}','') AS job_id, 'logged' AS status;

INSERT INTO content_errors (job_id, severity, error_code, error_message, recoverable, context) VALUES (NULLIF('{{$json.job_id}}','')::uuid, COALESCE('{{$json.severity}}','warning'), COALESCE('{{$json.error_code}}','STEP_FAILED'), COALESCE('{{$json.error_message}}',''), true, jsonb_build_object('step_name',COALESCE('{{$json.step_name}}','unknown'),'retry_safe','retry_count < max_retries','retry_count',COALESCE('{{$json.retry_count}}','0'))); SELECT NULLIF('{{$json.job_id}}','') AS job_id, 'logged' AS status;
